#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, k;
    scanf("%d %d", &n, &k);
    vector<int> a(n);
    vector<int> odd(n);
    int balance = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        scanf("%d", &a[i]);
        balance += (a[i] & 1) == 0 ? 1 : -1;
        odd[i] = balance;
    }

    map<int, vector<int>> groups;
    for (int i = 0; i + 1 < n; ++i) {
        int diff = abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]);
        groups[diff].push_back(i);
    }

    int ans = 0;
    for (auto &entry : groups) {
        int diff = entry.first;
        if (diff > k) break;
        vector<int> &indices = entry.second;
        sort(indices.begin(), indices.end());
        for (int idx : indices) {
            if (k >= diff && odd[idx] == 0) {
                k -= diff;
                ans++;
            }
        }
    }
    printf("%d\n", ans);
    return 0;
}
